native_mechanisms: Stone never resets between marks: one running state carries the callus of every earlier fold forward

Each mark's weight is pressed into the already-turned seated position, not a clean face, so early marks bend how later marks land (and one hair's difference is multiplied by each later fold, so no two folding paths reconverge)
Only the stone's final seated number against the wooden keeps leaves the desk; all intermediate turns and residue are swept away
core_technique: Wide (256-bit, 4x64) SIMD/ARX block accumulator — XOR 32-byte block, lane add (carry), rotate, lane permute per block, overlapping last-block tail, plus a separate xor-rotate-multiply path for short inputs and an xxHash/splitmix-style multiply-xor-shift finalizer that folds in the length: i.e. standard xxHash-family accumulator hashing.
